security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: See what a transaction really does before you approve it.
bundle.longDescription: Reads a Safe transaction and says what those bytes actually do, from the bytes alone. It holds no keys, signs nothing, and makes no network connection. Your hardware wallet still signs; this is the second pair of eyes.
